title: Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty: card flavor text

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane of kami and technology, brought to peace after the Kami War.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: A being whose guidance united the Empire; Michiko was the first mortal to bond with Kyodai.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: The first mortal to bond with Kyodai, who ended the Kami War and guided Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.

entities.name: Lord Konda
entities.description: A lord whose immortal body was turned to stone and shattered for transgressions against the kami.

entities.name: the Kami War
entities.description: A war ended by Michiko Konda and Kyodai, helped by the dark myojin's gifts.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: The Imperial seat guarded by mothriders and mechs.

entities.name: Imperial Palace
entities.description: The palace guarded by champions of the Imperial cause.

entities.name: the Empire
entities.description: The Imperial government of Kamigawa, led by an Emperor.

entities.name: the Emperor
entities.description: The Emperor, whose name custom forbids revealing, who appoints Light-Paws as regent while away.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: A wise advisor appointed to guide Kamigawa in the Emperor's absence.

entities.name: Aoha
entities.description: A general of the First Emperor who speaks of peace under Kyodai.

entities.name: Swift-Arm
entities.description: The Golden-Tail headmaster who tells a pup to become the western wind.

entities.name: Golden-Tail Academy
entities.description: A kitsune-led academy in Eiganjo for Imperial samurai.

entities.name: Yui
entities.description: An Imperial intercessor who tells intruders they overstayed their welcome.

entities.name: Onyx-Eye
entities.description: The architect of Eiganjo, a visionary who sees what could be.

entities.name: Kaito
entities.description: Close childhood friend of the Emperor who grabs the Reality Chip and charges into Jin-Gitaxias's lab.

entities.name: the Wanderer
entities.description: A planeswalker whose blade felled Jin-Gitaxias and whose spark was tethered by the Reality Chip; the Emperor.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who joins Kaito against Jin-Gitaxias and keeps the Reality Chip.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor coveting planeswalking secrets and lying in wait for Kaito and Tamiyo.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: A device that tethers the Wanderer's spark to Kamigawa and was entrusted to Tamiyo.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: A bridge unknown to Kaito until too late.

entities.name: Azami
entities.description: A teacher obsessed with the kami of forbidden knowledge as her students succumb to madness.

entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: Technologists who regard kami-bonding as anachronistic and seek to surpass spiritual power.

entities.name: Katsumasa, the Animator
entities.description: A Futurist who folded a paper model first.

entities.name: Emire
entities.description: Director of the Saiba Futurists.

entities.name: Arima
entities.description: A Futurist inventor addressing Emire about alloy.

entities.name: Saku
entities.description: A Futurist technician worried about machines no longer needing people.

entities.name: Eita
entities.description: A Futurist agent who plants a virus.

entities.name: Risona
entities.description: Leader of the Asari Uprisers.

entities.name: Asari Uprising
entities.description: A rebel group clashing with Imperials, to which Isshin gave his heart and swords.

entities.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
entities.description: A swordsman trained by Imperials who joined the Asari Uprising.

entities.name: Reki
entities.description: Founder of the Living Historians.

entities.name: Living Historians
entities.description: A group who embody the past.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Called the hero of the Kami War or a selfish thief.

entities.name: Takumi
entities.description: A Reckoner enforcer.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: A leader who directs Reckoners in force.

entities.name: Reckoners
entities.description: Gangs including the Mukotai and Okiba Reckoners who meet at the Dragon's Lair.

entities.name: Dragon's Lair
entities.description: A sacred, neutral meeting ground of all Reckoner gangs.

entities.name: Keni-Keni
entities.description: An akki smith.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: Small goblinoid beings who paint salvaged Imperial mechs.

entities.name: Kiki-Jiki
entities.description: A figure blessed by Keiga who would master duplication.

entities.name: Keiga, the Tide Star
entities.description: A dragon-kami who blessed Kiki-Jiki.

entities.name: Kenji
entities.description: A Sokenzan artisan.

entities.name: Sokenzan City
entities.description: A city of artisans who reuse scrap.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: A city built around Boseiju that clear-cut Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: A forest of kami that turned hostile after clear-cutting.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: An ancient tree around which Towashi was built.

entities.name: Shigeki
entities.description: Founder of the Order of Jukai.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: Agents who commune with kami for martial prowess.

entities.name: Chiyoko
entities.description: A Jukai elder who gives out Bronze Cudgels.

entities.name: Seshiro
entities.description: Anointed Broodmaster of the Orochi Colonies.

entities.name: Shin
entities.description: A Towashi street performer.

entities.name: Fumika
entities.description: An Imperial enforcer.

entities.name: Azusa
entities.description: A speaker who asks for a new journey.

entities.name: Norika Yamazaki
entities.description: A poet who says peace is built with words.

entities.name: Heiko Yamazaki
entities.description: A general who lets her sword do the talking.

entities.name: Naomi
entities.description: A figure calling for rising above petty quarrels.

entities.name: Raiyuu
entities.description: A figure who needs only the tempest as ally.

entities.name: Greasefang
entities.description: The Okiba boss.

entities.name: Hinata
entities.description: A figure on sunlit hooves.

entities.name: Hirori
entities.description: A child who becomes the city's biggest hero by piloting a mech.

entities.name: Touma
entities.description: An ogre who hates doors.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders led by praetors.

events.summary: Imperials invoke Kyodai's name to banish a foe.
events.quote: In the name of Kyodai, begone!

events.summary: Eiganjo's moths were persuaded to bear riders over years of patience.
events.quote: It took years of patience and dedication to convince them to bear riders.

events.summary: Michiko Konda entrusts the future to her sister.
events.quote: now I must entrust the future to my sister.

events.summary: Aoha declares peace under Kyodai's guidance.
events.quote: Now, united at last under Kyodai's guidance, we lay down our weapons and open our minds.

events.summary: Lord Konda is turned to stone and shattered for transgressions against the kami.
events.quote: For his transgressions against the kami, Lord Konda's immortal body was turned to stone, then shattered into a thousand still-living pieces.

events.summary: Michiko Konda bonds with Kyodai, ending the Kami War.
events.quote: Michiko Konda brought an end to the Kami War and guided Kamigawa into an age of truth and harmony.

events.summary: Swift-Arm sends a young samurai into the sky as a mothrider.
events.quote: Be proud, young pup! You've earned your wings.

events.summary: The Emperor appoints Light-Paws to guide Kamigawa in her absence.
events.quote: the Emperor appointed the wise Light-Paws to guide Kamigawa in her absence.

events.summary: Yui tells an intruder they have overstayed their welcome.
events.quote: You are a guest in this realm, and you've overstayed your welcome.

events.summary: Onyx-Eye speaks of seeing what rubble could become.
events.quote: A visionary looks at rubble and sees not only what was, but also what could be.

events.summary: The Wanderer cuts Jin-Gitaxias out of the fight.
events.quote: Just as Jin-Gitaxias's victory seemed certain, the Wanderer appeared, her blade already in motion.

events.summary: Custom forbids the Emperor from revealing her name even to Kaito.
events.quote: Imperial custom strictly forbade the Emperor to reveal her name—even to Kaito, her closest childhood friend

events.summary: The Reality Chip tethers the Wanderer's wayward spark to Kamigawa.
events.quote: The Wanderer sighed in relief as the Reality Chip tethered her wayward spark to Kamigawa.

events.summary: Azami's students go mad as her obsession with forbidden knowledge grows.
events.quote: Even as her students' minds succumbed to madness, Azami's obsession with the kami of forbidden knowledge only grew.

events.summary: Futurists reject kami-bonding in favor of technology.
events.quote: The Futurists regard the tradition of kami-bonding as anachronistic and inefficient

events.summary: Katsumasa folds a paper model to test plate strength.
events.quote: I folded a model in paper first to test the relative tensile strength of the plates.

events.summary: Emire urges rising above the squabble below.
events.quote: While they squabble below, let us rise above.

events.summary: Risona incredulously questions a mech blown away.
events.quote: Are you seriously telling me your heavy combat mech . . . blew away?

events.summary: Emire plans to hide secrets in a bauble from Imperial searches.
events.quote: Let the Imperials search our laboratories.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias covets planeswalking secrets and tests spirits.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias had long coveted the secrets of planeswalking.

events.summary: Kaito grabs the Reality Chip hoping for answers.
events.quote: Kaito grabbed the chip, hoping it held answers.

events.summary: Tamiyo and Kaito are unprepared for the praetor.
events.quote: For all their planning, Tamiyo and Kaito were unprepared to face the full power of a Phyrexian praetor.

events.summary: Hirori leaps into a mech pilot's seat and becomes a hero.
events.quote: Hirori went from smallest kid on the block to biggest hero in the city.

events.summary: Kaito closes on his quarry unaware of the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: Kaito knew every rooftop in the city, and closed in quickly on his quarry—but he knew nothing of the Planar Bridge until it was already too late.

events.summary: Reki describes Toshiro as hero of the Kami War or a selfish thief.
events.quote: Some called him the hero of the Kami War, others a selfish thief.

events.summary: The dark myojin's gifts help end the Kami War.
events.quote: The dark myojin's gifts were instrumental in ending the Kami War.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias dismisses a test, saying incompleat flesh is weak.
events.quote: A minor test, nothing more. Incompleat flesh is weak.

events.summary: Takumi presses for more tribute.
events.quote: That's a start. What else do you have for us?

events.summary: Reckoners hold yearly restricted auctions at the Dragon's Lair.
events.quote: Restricted auctions are held once a year at the Dragon's Lair

events.summary: Satoru Umezawa orders a hurt fighter to keep fighting.
events.quote: You stop fighting when I say, and not a moment sooner.

events.summary: Eita boasts of a virus that will cost enemies days.
events.quote: They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!

events.summary: Keni-Keni advises akki to carry the furnace's heat in steel.
events.quote: Carry the heat of the furnace in your steel, and never let it fade.

events.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo charge into Jin-Gitaxias's lab, which he expected.
events.quote: Kaito and Tamiyo charged headlong into Jin-Gitaxias's secret lab, unaware that the praetor was eagerly awaiting their arrival.

events.summary: Keiga blesses Kiki-Jiki with duplication.
events.quote: Blessed by Keiga, the Tide Star, Kiki-Jiki would one day master the art of duplication.

events.summary: Kenji comments on an Ironhoof Boar restoring someone's running.
events.quote: I'm glad she can run again, but this might have been a bit much.

events.summary: The first Imperials subdue the clans over decades after the Kami War.
events.quote: In the wake of the Kami War, Kamigawa descended into a state of constant warfare.

events.summary: Sokenzan artisans take pride in reusing metal.
events.quote: Among the artisans of Sokenzan City, reusing every scrap of metal is a point of pride.

events.summary: Azusa asks for a new journey.
events.quote: I ask for nothing more than a new journey and a fresh path to greet my feet when I wake each morning.

events.summary: The builders of Towashi razed the forest but left Boseiju unscathed.
events.quote: Though they razed the surrounding forest, the builders of Towashi left Boseiju unscathed, shaping the city around the ancient tree.

events.summary: Reki warns that history must be nurtured.
events.quote: If we do not nurture the garden of history, we may once more wander blindly through barren lands.

events.summary: Shigeki promises to give invaders a taste of their poison.
events.quote: Let me give you a taste of the poison you've poured into our land.

events.summary: Clear-cutting for Towashi made Jukai Forest hostile to outsiders.
events.quote: After large sections were clear-cut to build Towashi, the once-peaceful Jukai Forest grew violently hostile to outsiders.

events.summary: An ancient kami awakens beneath the city as pavement rips.
events.quote: Pavement ripped like paper as the ancient kami awoke from her long slumber beneath the city.

events.summary: Seshiro urges making friends in times of strife.
events.quote: In times of strife, the foolish make a fist while the wise make a friend.

events.summary: The Wanderer entrusts the Reality Chip to Tamiyo to keep it from Jin-Gitaxias.
events.quote: To keep the Reality Chip out of Jin-Gitaxias's hands, the Wanderer entrusted it to Tamiyo.

events.summary: Two visions of freedom clash at the gates of the Imperial Palace.
events.quote: Two different visions of freedom clashed at the gates of the Imperial Palace.

events.summary: Isshin leaves the Imperials for the Asari Uprising.
events.quote: he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

events.summary: Saku wonders if machines will stop needing people.
events.quote: Will there come a day when they no longer need us?

events.summary: Chiyoko hands over cudgels made when Michiko was young.
events.quote: These were made when Michiko was young. Wield them wisely.

events.summary: Satoru Umezawa orders a message sent to enemies.
events.quote: Send them a message they can't ignore.

events.summary: Arima tells Emire the alloy was for a colossus.
events.quote: is what I needed all that alloy for.

events.summary: Fumika berates a guard who left the entrance unguarded.
events.quote: And what, precisely, was so important that you left the entrance unguarded?

events.summary: The first Imperials forge a servant to tend Eiganjo's shrines.
events.quote: From broken swords, the first Imperials forged a peaceful servant to tend the shrines of Eiganjo.

events.summary: An akki inventor's greeting is met with shrieks and alarms.
events.quote: To her dismay, the greeting was met only with shrieks and alarms being activated.

events.summary: Merge sites are stabilized by automated units.
events.quote: Automated units are deployed to stabilize merge sites deemed too dangerous even for trained intercessors.
